note: Data artifacts produced by the buggy v1.4.6 pf_trust-routed stack (commit d29a17e) and anything that consumed its parser output. Marked SUPERSEDED for v1.5; history is NOT deleted. The defect is recorded in detail in analysis/v1.5/errata.json / Phase B8.

root_cause.bug: The v1.4.6 summary parser called raw.strip() on each summary line, which stripped the TRAILING TAB of a PROVEN-with-empty-axiom-set line ('name\tPRESENT\t'). That dropped the line from 3 columns to 2, so parse_summary returned None and the WHOLE batch was marked untrusted (UNKNOWN). A zero-axiom provable goal is legitimately PROVEN (empty set subset of ALLOWED_AXIOMS). Fixed in v1.4.7 by stripping only ' \r\n' (never tabs). v1.5 PHASE B3/B4 add fuzz + canary tests that would have caught it.
